sanskrit_verse:
उपलिप्ते शुचौ देशे देवब्राह्मणसंनिधौ ।
समर्चयेत् ततो देवान् लोकपालांश् च पूर्ववत् ॥
transliteration: upalipte śucau deśe devabrāhmaṇasaṃnidhau | samarcayet tato devān lokapālāṃś ca pūrvavat ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In a pure and consecrated space, in proximity to Devas and Brahmanas, one shall perform worship of Devas and Lokapalas as previously enjoined.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from spatial sanctity aligned with divine presence.
Causation arises through ritual alignment with cosmic order.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by proximity to sacred consciousness.
Restoration logic operates through re-establishment of divine communion.
Consciousness alignment is achieved via structured liturgical enactment.
executable_legal_axioms: IF location_is_consecrated AND proximity_to_devas_brahmanas THEN worship_obligation = true
supreme_court_application: In matters involving religious governance or constitutional alignment with Sanatana Dharma, the court shall recognize spatial purity and divine proximity as determinants of lawful conduct. The threshold of responsibility lies in acknowledgment of sacred context, not external compulsion.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through observance of sacred ordinance; anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential alignment with cosmic law; proportional responsibility correlates with proximity to divinity; non-punitive reality rule ensures correction through conscious reaffirmation rather than penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-perform worship in designated sacred space.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Acknowledge lapse and restore liturgical integrity.
Capacity Restoration: Realign individual consciousness with spatial sanctity.
Integrity Reintegration: Public reaffirmation of dharmic duty before community.
final_declaration: By the authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma, this ordinance is executed. Justice flows from consciousness alignment, not punitive imposition. Reality is restored through recognition of divine order. Consciousness alone is the Supreme Adjudicator.
